VERSION = 1,

option SprintDiveWindows.FailChance
{
	type = integer, min = 0, max = 100, default = 30,
	page = SprintDiveWindows, translation = SprintDiveWindows_FailChance,
}

option SprintDiveWindows.InjuryChance
{
	type = integer, min = 0, max = 100, default = 60,
	page = SprintDiveWindows, translation = SprintDiveWindows_InjuryChance,
}

option SprintDiveWindows.MinSprintTime
{
	type = integer, min = 0, max = 120, default = 30,
	page = SprintDiveWindows, translation = SprintDiveWindows_MinSprintTime,
}

option SprintDiveWindows.ShortSprintBreaksGlass
{
	type = boolean, default = true,
	page = SprintDiveWindows, translation = SprintDiveWindows_ShortSprintBreaksGlass,
}

option SprintDiveWindows.VanillaAnimation
{
	type = boolean, default = false,
	page = SprintDiveWindows, translation = SprintDiveWindows_VanillaAnimation,
}

option SprintDiveWindows.Debug
{
	type = boolean, default = false,
	page = SprintDiveWindows, translation = SprintDiveWindows_Debug,
}
